Industrial technology for water, energy and infrastructure

Meridian Industrial Group is a global company that designs and manufactures pumps, valves and control systems. Our three businesses serve water utilities, energy producers and infrastructure builders in 14 countries, from 22 plants and 12,400 people.

Explore our businesses Contact us

Our businesses

  • Meridian Water — pumps, treatment skids and network controls for utilities and irrigation.
  • Meridian Energy Systems — valves and flow control for power generation, hydrogen and LNG.
  • Meridian Infrastructure — tunnel ventilation, fire systems and building controls for large projects.

Meridian at a glance

Founded in Sydney in 1962. Listed on the ASX (MIG). Revenue of A$3.1 billion in the last financial year. 12,400 employees across 22 manufacturing plants and 60 service centres.
